salary_baseline: 2025 national median; gov figures reflect OPM 2025 base pay + Rest of US locality

levels.title: Cloud Security Analyst I
skills: AWS IAM fundamentals
SIEM basics (Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel)
CloudTrail log review
Security monitoring and alerting
Python scripting for automation
Linux command line (RHCSA-level)
OWASP Top 10 awareness
Vulnerability scanning basics (Nessus/Qualys)
levels.next_steps: Get hands-on with AWS labs — IAM policy analysis, S3 bucket auditing, and GuardDuty. Earn AWS SAA to prove cloud-native fluency.
levels.milestone: First security-adjacent job, internship, or lab-verified portfolio project.

levels.title: Cloud Security Analyst II / Jr. Cloud Security Engineer
skills: AWS Security Hub and GuardDuty configuration
IAM policy authoring and least-privilege enforcement
Terraform basics for IaC provisioning
S3 bucket policy and ACL hardening
CSPM tools (Prisma Cloud or Wiz basics)
Container image scanning (Trivy or Grype)
Security automation with Python and boto3
Incident triage and escalation workflows
CIS Benchmarks and NIST 800-53 mapping
levels.next_steps: Own a real automation project end-to-end — auto-remediation of S3 public access or IAM credential aging. Start touching IaC security scanning (tfsec, Checkov).
levels.milestone: Deployed security automation or CSPM integration that reduced findings in a real environment.

levels.title: Cloud Security Engineer
skills: Threat modeling with STRIDE
IaC security scanning (Checkov, tfsec, Semgrep)
AWS Security Specialty service suite (Macie, Inspector, Detective)
Kubernetes security and KSPM (kube-bench, Falco)
Container security hardening and runtime monitoring
SBOM generation and software supply chain security
Zero-trust architecture design
Service control policies (SCPs) and AWS Organizations
Secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)
SAST/DAST integration into CI/CD pipelines
levels.next_steps: Lead a threat model for a production workload. Build a full CSPM-to-SIEM pipeline. Pursue CISSP to unlock leadership roles.
levels.milestone: Owns one or more security workstreams independently — from design through implementation and monitoring.

levels.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
skills: Security architecture design for multi-account AWS environments
AWS Control Tower and Landing Zone governance
Advanced IAM — permission boundaries, ABAC, cross-account roles
Cloud-native SIEM tuning and detection engineering
Red team / purple team collaboration and adversary emulation (MITRE ATT&CK Cloud)
Compliance automation (FedRAMP, SOC 2, PCI-DSS)
Data security — encryption key management, KMS, data classification
API security and OAuth/OIDC threat patterns
Mentoring junior engineers and running security design reviews
Risk communication to non-technical stakeholders
levels.next_steps: Design and present a security reference architecture for a new product. Lead a purple team exercise. Begin contributing to org-level security standards docs.
levels.milestone: Technical lead on a cross-team security initiative — delivered on time, measurable risk reduction.

levels.title: Staff / Principal Cloud Security Engineer

gov.clearance: Top Secret / SCI with CI Poly

skills: Enterprise security strategy and program design
Cross-org security standards authorship (security policy, architecture ADRs)
Advanced threat intelligence integration and operationalization
CSPM and CNAPP program ownership across multiple BUs
Supply chain security — SLSA framework, sigstore, in-toto
AI/ML workload security (model poisoning, data exfiltration, LLM threat modeling)
Security economics — cost/risk tradeoff framing for C-suite
Executive-level risk reporting and board-level security briefings
Hiring, growing, and retaining security talent
Open source security tooling contribution or industry publication
levels.next_steps: Define the 3-year security roadmap for an org or business unit. Speak at a conference (re:Inforce, BSides, DEF CON). Evaluate the CISO-track vs. technical fellow track.
levels.milestone: Recognized as the internal authority on cloud security — other teams seek your review before shipping.

levels.title: Distinguished Engineer / CISO-Track Executive

gov.clearance: Top Secret / SCI with Full Scope Poly
example_orgs: Office of the National Cyber Director

skills: Security organizational design and headcount planning
M&A security due diligence
Regulatory and legislative engagement (CISA, FTC, SEC)
Board and investor-level security governance
Zero-trust enterprise program leadership
Threat landscape strategic forecasting
Industry coalition leadership (ISACs, CISA advisories)
Post-incident congressional or regulatory testimony
Published security research or industry standards body participation (IETF, NIST NCCoE)
Security culture change management at scale
certs: Executive education programs (Harvard Kennedy School Cybersecurity, Carnegie Mellon CISO Executive)
levels.next_steps: This is the destination, not a waypoint. Focus: strategic influence, talent pipeline, and defining what cloud security means for the next decade at your organization or industry-wide.
levels.milestone: Accountable for security posture of an entire organization or agency — reported at the board/Congress level.
